title: Audit and repair the next ten Admin growth APIs

spec.problem: The next ten active Admin growth METHOD+PATH APIs have incomplete method-level authorization, validation, status, persistence/audit, or error handling; callers and OpenAPI must retain aligned contracts.

acceptance.text: GET /api/admin/growth/campaigns/audience-estimate enforces the campaign-read permission, validates supported filters (including UI plan/country where data supports them), and returns correct counts or 500 on DB failure.
GET /api/admin/growth/campaigns/{id} validates UUID, returns 404 only for missing campaign, and reports audit query/scan/iteration failures rather than partial success.

PATCH /api/admin/growth/campaigns/{id} requires growth.manage and trusted-origin CSRF; validates body/reason/UUID; returns accurate 400/404/500; updates selected fields and before/after actor audit atomically.
POST /api/admin/growth/campaigns/{id}/activate requires growth.manage and CSRF, validates reason/UUID and state transition, and atomically persists status plus actor audit.
POST /api/admin/growth/campaigns/{id}/archive requires growth.manage and CSRF, validates reason/UUID and state transition, and atomically persists status plus actor audit.
POST /api/admin/growth/campaigns/{id}/duplicate requires growth.manage and CSRF, validates reason/UUID, creates a draft copy and actor audit atomically, and returns the copy contract.
POST /api/admin/growth/campaigns/{id}/end requires growth.manage and CSRF, validates reason/UUID and state transition, and atomically persists status plus actor audit.
POST /api/admin/growth/campaigns/{id}/schedule requires growth.manage and CSRF, validates reason/UUID and state transition/schedule constraints, and atomically persists status plus actor audit.
GET /api/admin/growth/postcards enforces the correct Growth read permissions, filters/paginates only postcard kinds, and reports query/scan/iteration errors.
POST /api/admin/growth/postcards requires the appropriate write permission and CSRF, validates privacy/content fields, returns accurate status and atomically persists postcard plus audit.
The direct Next.js runtime dependency is upgraded to a release patched for the three critical advisories reported for 16.2.4, and learner/Admin production builds still pass.

spec.expected_behavior: Every API enforces the right permission and CSRF on writes, validates untrusted input, returns accurate contract/status and missing-row errors, persists mutations with actor audit atomically, preserves frontend behavior, and uses a Next.js version patched for the known critical advisories.
spec.observed_behavior: Current Go handlers rely mainly on AdminGuard; campaign reads ignore audit query failures, PATCH/transition/duplicate ignore DB and audit errors and do not transact; audience estimate ignores supported filters and the default free plan; postcard list skips row errors; postcard create behavior requires verification against schema, OpenAPI and callers. The installed Next.js 16.2.4 also has three critical production advisories.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only the AUDIT-146 implementation commit; no schema changes are planned and tests/browser use uniquely named disposable campaigns/postcards with cleanup.

classification.rationale: Repair ten Admin Growth API contracts and estimate behavior, keep the campaign estimate display truthful for unsupported filters, and update the direct Next.js dependency to a patched release for three verified critical advisories.
